ratings.comment: Does not prepare for lectures ever. He does not even know what questions will be on the quiz and how the cheat sheet look like. He spends 40 minutes talking about things assuming you know all the basics. I feel like I don't learn anything from his class. I have to borrow notes from other professors to pass it.

I took this class online over the Summer. I would not recommend. This class made me have an extreme dislike toward transistors, which made ECE342 very hard for me as well. The TA did not respond to my emails very well. Prof Hitchon makes the lectures videos, the TA makes the quizzes. Big disconnect between the material covered and the quiz material

ECE 220 gives me very bad experience, that the videos are full of background noice, which drives me crazy whenever I want to focous. And I can't believe the grade for A is somewhere around 95 ECE 235 give ms some bad experience, professor often skips crusial steps that he thinks is "not worth mentioning "
He was impossible to contact, the videos were grainy and he gave me a BC for an 88% in his course (nowhere does he talk about any kind of curve in his course). I would avoid him at all costs.
I'm just gonna state this clear and flat. As summer school students, we only have his noisy and scattered videos to watch. And his B line is above 94. What kind of person does that.

I thought Prof. Hitchon was really instructive in lectures/discussion, and he got me motivated about the material. The lecture videos are okay and only need be skimmed over before going to class. Basically, attending all the classes and applying yourself should get you an A, and he cares about getting to know students and helping them.

Anyone complaining about this professor didn't actually show up to class. If you only rely on the video lectures for this class, you won't do well. You need to show up for class to ask him questions and work specific problems. He is very helpful and good at explaining some of the more arcane topics.
Worst professor I've had at UW. If you want to learn, refuse to take a class with him.
Absolutely useless video lectures that are unclear and long-winded.

Easy class, poorly taught. Consists of watching poorly made lecture videos + taking a quiz every 2 weeks. No Exams. There are also 2-3 homework assignments and a final project, which is reasonably easy. All assignments and quizzes are created and graded by your TA, but if they're too hard, complain to Hitchon + he'll get them fixed.

Never have I seen a professor put as little effort into a course as Professor Hitchon. Lectures are recorded videos from past semesters. No exams, but quizzes every other week that are written by the TA. Very little homework, and end of the year "project" that is extremely vague and unorganized. Success in the class solely depends on the TA.
No homework, no textbook, but 7 quizzes. professor did a great job to explain the physical meaning of formula. The easiness is highly depends on TA.

Easiest ECE course you are going to take.  Fine if you are CMPE.  DO NOT TAKE 220 WITH HIM IF YOU ARE EE.  YOU WILL LEARN NOTHING.   Lazy teaching at its worst if you need to actually learn the material.

I had 220 with him and figured this would be an easier version of 420 where I'd get a good E&M review and still learn something. Turns out, I didn't learn much. He barely scratched the surface of concepts. Good if you just need an easy course, but not so great if you need to be forced to learn material. That said, he's very helpful and approachable

Come on, people! Forget about Up Series! Professor Hitchon is good not because he was in some documentary, but because he is smart and very helpful! Definitely take him if you can; you will learn a lot in his class!

Just make sure you understand the general concepts and you'll do fine. I literally never thought about class when I wasn't in it. I recommend attending lecture though. Get to know Hitchon too, he's a cool guy.

Can not understand why so many students love him. He is the WORST prof ever in the department. Talk only about simplest material. Can not learn anything from this guy. If you want to get an easy A and be a terrible engineer, take him then.
Watch the documentary 49 UP! He's in it, and it's awesome

if you want to get an easy A or AB, then take him ... if you actually wanna learn stuff, then dont ... he covers the very bare minimum he can get away with .. and skips a lot of material. absolute no use of textbook. but he cares about his students and tries to make sure everyone knows the covered material; even though he does not hold office hrs!

Worst professor I  have ever had. Doesn't assign a textbook. Covers only a fraction of the necessary material. Plays favorites. Easiness depends entirely on TAs, as they are responsible for all practice and test material. Does a great job of explaining div, curl, and displacement current. Haphazardly covers the rest of the material.

Fun class that isn't very thorough, so it's great for CmpE majors and not so great for EEs. It's too bad- Hitchon is pretty smart and is never afraid to "tell it like it is"- he could teach this course more rigorously and still make it quite comprehensible.

Poor Prof.  Disorganized and plays favorites.  Had students in my class who were Profs collegues kids.  Lots of favoritism.  Don"t take a ckass from Hitchon if you need to use the info he teaches - you will have trouble using the info he is paid to teach you. The poorest Prof I had all through my BS, MS and PhD studies!
You cant beat that guy, amazingly brilliant and I havent seen any better prof. when it comes to grading, so enjoy his class :)
Awesome professor, Google seven up series!

Don't bother taking a class with him if you have to take one later which builds on the knowledge taught by him.  He is really easy and a really nice/funny guy, so if you're looking for a good grade and a good time you should take him, but the information he teaches is not sufficient for you to enter the next class.

One of the best professors I've had.  Makes dry ECE material actually relevant to students, truly a breath of fresh air when contrasted with professors who do nothing but copy from a text book all day.

if your not an EE major, take him, he is awesome for 220, you will learn the fundamentals - but he barely  involves any math into it, so if you have to take higher level electrodynamics classes try to avoid him if possible (unless he is teaching those as well...) no exams! only small quizzes, no HW

Really easy class if taken with him. No homework, no textbook. Just go to all the classes and take notes. Quiz questions come right from notes. And make sure he knows your name! or your grade will get docked in the end.
Easy class.  He seems lazy, but he works very hard to make us learn and understand the concepts, and he does a very good job of that.
Hitch is featured in a documentary called 49up! If you've ever had him check it out, its a pretty call film.
You need a pulse to get an A.
If you see a course taught by this prof, take it.  Even if you are not in ECE.  BME's will love him.

This class in general is pretty easy but nick is a great and funny guy who just wants to make things as enjoyable as possible.  I would recommend taking any of nick's classes based solely on the fact that hes funny and easy going. Oh yeah, he gave me an A.

Made these two difficult ECE courses understandable, digestable, and generally easy. Loves to joke around & always wants to make sure every student is understanding material. Makes class easy enough that you could skip, but I went every day just to have fun watching him teach and show his passion.
Hitch is awesome.
Fun times in this class, Nick is a great person who teaches more about the real world than the subject.
One of the best professors I've ever had.  Really engages the students in the material. Likes to use the word buggers ALOT!

Coolest professor EVER.  Engages student attention, jokes around, teaches very boring material extraordinarily well (I can actually understand some electrodynamics now!).  Worth taking for anything no matter what -- I'm taking 2 summer classes with him!

Great professor.  More interested in teaching students than grading them.  The downside is that he probably won't prepare you for ECE 320.  However, you can always assign yourself extra homework if you really want...

Fun teacher, classes were enjoyable excpet I learned more from the TA then him. Don't plan on learning too much from him because he doesn't teach very well, but if your looking for an easy class take one of his.
